Title: Azure Data Factory mapping data flows adds SQL scripts to sink transformation

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory has added a new capability that allows you to execute custom SQL scripts from your SQL sink transformation in mapping data flows. Now you can easily perform options such as disabling indexes, allows identity inserts, and other DDL/DML operations from data flows.

Read more.
